translations.web: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
translations.bsb: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
translations.kjv: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
translations.asv: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.
